card.name: Study wording before a diagnosis or condition
card.fires_on: Small words in study-method sentences that come just before a diagnosis or condition, such as 'had', 'before the', and 'excluding patients'. It is seen in epidemiology text about cancer or heart failure.

modes.label: Participants and conditions
modes.description: Words in 'None of the participants had' just before heart failure.
modes.example: None of the participants<< had>> heart failure at the start of the study

modes.label: Exclusion wording
modes.description: The word 'patients' after 'excluding' in a study description.
modes.example: After excluding<< patients>> in whom exposure to study drug was less

modes.label: Time before diagnosis
modes.description: 'before' or 'the' in a phrase about use before the cancer diagnosis.
